Name: vanguard-outpost
History: The first survey camp raised after the Fracture. Its crew went into the canopy to map the tears and the radio has only carried birdsong since.

Name: whispering-canopies
History: Old growth that kept growing while the sky broke. Hunters say the leaves repeat the last words spoken beneath them.

Name: fracture-grottos
History: Where the ground split cleanly and the caves inside do not match the hill above them.

Name: magma-forge
History: The Foundry Guild forged the first Anchor plating here before the mountain woke. The forges still run; nobody is left to stoke them.

Name: obsidian-ridge
History: A black glass spine cooled in a single night. Scavengers cut blades from it and do not say what the blades remember.

Name: smoldering-trench
History: A fault line that never stopped burning. Convoys detour a day's drive around it.

Name: summit-array
History: The last tower to answer the Fracture signal. It still transmits, on a frequency no one assigned.

Name: glacial-crevasse
History: Ice that split along the Fracture lines and froze open. The blue depths hold wrecked expedition sleds.

Name: avalanche-run
History: A slope loosened by the array's pulses. It lets go without warning to anyone not listening for it.

Name: aether-lift
History: A cable lift built to carry cargo to the summit. It now carries only the cold.

Name: scrap-outpost
History: Raiders and honest salvagers share this wall under an uneasy truce, and both sell the same scrap back to the Nexus.

Name: grid-iron-highway
History: The old trunk road, flattened by the Fracture and re-laid by whoever needed it most.

Name: convoy-sprint
History: A long straight where supply runs race the dust storms. The wrecks along it mark the runs that lost.

Name: solar-array
History: Mirror fields that once powered half the coast. They still gather light, and now they aim it.

Name: glass-flats
History: Sand fused by a single flare. Footprints from before the Fracture are still pressed into it.

Name: sunken-arcology
History: A habitat tower that sank in the dunes, vault doors still sealed from inside.

Name: quicksand-basin
History: Dunes that shift on a schedule nobody has worked out. Maps of it go stale within a day.

Name: airboat-hub
History: Boardwalk stations strung across the bog. The boats still run to a timetable written before the water rose.

Name: weeping-mangroves
History: Roots that bleed amber sap into the mire. The sap is a catalyst, and it is also a lure.

Name: temple-of-echoes
History: A shrine that predates the Fracture and answers questions no one asked aloud.

Name: spatial-sink
History: A place where distance folds. Things dropped in arrive somewhere else, usually somewhere worse.

Name: transit-plaza
History: The first place the Fracture refugees gathered. Every route out of the safe zone starts under its clock.

Name: spire-district
History: Tower blocks of the old council. The Director governs from the top floor.

Name: scrapyard-bazaar
History: A market built on whatever the Wastelands send back. Everything has a price and a story.

Name: aqua-shipyard
History: Hulls laid down for a sea that moved. The slipways face a coast that is no longer there.

Name: neon-city
History: The district that kept its lights on through the Fracture, for reasons its owners will not explain.

Name: thalassia
History: A drowned city below the surface, still lit. Whatever keeps it lit does not want visitors.
